how_to_get: The application text is /mnt/project-files/data-requests/radiopaedia-application-draft.md (the thread's file); the agreement is SignNow document 2b7a4819d4ea45198cd8e71ba0703993ba89663b, sent to andrew.murphy+ml@radiopaedia.org with license@radiopaedia.org in copy.
